commits.author: NidhalNaffati
commits.message:
feat: Add account locking feature to validateCredentials method

Implemented a feature in the validateCredentials method of UserService to lock user accounts after a specified number of failed login attempts. This feature enhances security by preventing brute-force attacks on user accounts. Added unit tests to ensure the functionality works correctly, covering scenarios such as locking an account after reaching the maximum failed login attempts and resetting the account locking state after a successful login.

commits.author: NidhalNaffati
commits.message:
feat: Add password validation

Implemented password validation checks for length, inclusion of digits, lowercase and uppercase letters, and matching confirm password. The "Create account" button is now disabled until all password requirements are met. This ensures users cannot proceed with an invalid password.

Refactor router configuration and guards

This commit improves code organization and readability, making the router setup more modular and easier to maintain.
